set.body: Deliver the deferred eyes4s-vwp consumer over v1.0 Timeline, AoiSet, Trials, plans and codecs. Primitive traces are entity-primary and estimand-indexed; roles are pure construal projections. First analyses cover realized preview, role/filler dissociation, alternative construals, role-resolution paths and production/onset alignment, with export-ready support diagnostics and no in-library GAMM/GLMM, forced alignment, or automatic role inference.
set.title: v1.1 — Visual-world relational attention
